scope: Public server-rendered Google authorization fallback repair for the current personal schedule site.

repair.observed_defect: Before client hydration, the Google identity control could render without a native click target even though the canonical authorization route was available.
repair.new_behavior: Until Google Identity Services is ready, server rendering exposes a native anchor to canonical /auth/google. Once the identity script is ready, the existing Google identity button replaces the fallback.
repair.unchanged_boundaries: The canonical OAuth route, Better Auth session flow, email auth, tenant derivation, privacy consent, D1/R2 bindings, and frozen visual routes are unchanged.

not_proven: A completed Google account selection and callback on Version 129.
A completed email registration, verification, reset, and sign-in replay on Version 129.
Current Version 129 A/B tenant isolation or physical second-device history readback.
